svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 2 — Panel 3: KEY BEAT — Theodore at Cribbage's bench, both benches visible
svg.desc: Wide medium 35mm eye level full width of both workbenches. Theodore has crossed the workshop and stands at Cribbage's main bench, pointing at the bent barrel hook inside the Whitfield mainspring assembly with a fine-tipped tool. He traces the geometry — earnest, careful, not trying to show up his master. Cribbage leans in, loupe dropped over one eye, grudging attention. Workshop wraps around them: tools on wall pegs, shelves of clocks, brass surfaces reflecting amber. Full warm gaslight on both figures. The moment cleverness risks being noticed.
